answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital commitment, preventing a lone actor from gaining control by spawning cheap nodes. Like surveying a knoll to extract shale or planting a cedar, one must invest real assets to secure authority. An attacker faces prohibitive costs because acquiring a majority stake requires massive market liquidity, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically irrational and technically futile.
